name: M5 x 12 countersunk screw
summary: Sits flush in a 90 degree countersink, head 11.2 mm across. 12 mm long overall.
source: ISO 10642 values for M5: theoretical head diameter 11.2 mm, head height 3.1 mm, 90 degree head. Unlike a cap screw, a countersunk screw is measured including its head, so 12 mm is the whole screw.
